newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan's King Hussein and Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu warned against the danger of extremism in the Middle East peace process.
- A $50 million placing in Lebanon Holdings was oversubscribed.
- A one billion Egyptian pound Saudi agricultural firm was set up in Egypt.
- The new Moroccan government includes four women.
- A Syrian team held talks in Iraq on a border dispute.
- Morocco's housing minister urged Arab businessmen to invest in the real estate sector.
- A U.S. economic team discussed investment opportunities in Lebanon.
